**Finding: deviation (WARRANTY)** — submitted.

Article VIX contains only a warranty disclaimer: the Licensed Technology is provided "AS IS," all express and implied warranties (merchantability, non-infringement, fitness, title, accuracy) are disclaimed, and Licensor affirmatively does not warrant that nonconformity to the documentation can or will be corrected. A document-wide search confirmed no affirmative performance or conformance warranty and no repair/replace/refund remedy anywhere — the remaining "warrants" references are Licensee-side breach triggers or mutual boilerplate about consulting counsel.

That places the deal at the rule's walk-away position, so the redline (validated ok:true):
- Carves the express warranties out of the AS-IS disclaimer at p0110.
- Inserts a limited warranty after p0116: workmanlike services, 12-month software / 90-day services conformance to documentation, legal compliance, no malicious code, with re-performance, repair/replacement or refund of fees as the remedy (at Licensor's option), with the 90-day fallback flagged in the comment as a negotiation concession.
